items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Fess came here and spent a couple of weeks here with me... I know that I'm going to resume some old friendships down there

ctx.x: It may be this same card. That's right. I'm not sure if it's the same one. It all started to turn brown.
Well, you see, Fess came here and spent a couple of weeks here with me.
And he said to be sure and give you his regards. I would have forgotten if you hadn't brought up his name and so many things to think of.
